info.name: Don't Blow Up
info.ruleText:
The deck is full of cards that let you avoid, delay and sabotage - and of exploding cats. On your turn you may play any number of cards and then you must draw one. Draw an exploding cat and you are out of the game, unless you can play a Laser Pointer, which lets you secretly slide the cat back into the deck anywhere you like.

Cat cards have no power on their own, but two matching cats let you take a random card from another player, three matching cats let you name the card you take, and five different cats let you pick any card out of the discard pile.

There is always one exploding cat less in the deck than there are players, so the game always ends with exactly one survivor.
info.description: Take turns drawing cards until somebody pulls an exploding cat. Skips, attacks, peeks and stolen cards let you push the danger onto everybody else, and a Laser Pointer lets you survive one explosion and hide the cat back in the deck. The last player who has not blown up wins.
info.helpText:
Goal: do not draw an exploding cat. The last player who has not blown up wins.

Setting up: everybody sits down, then somebody presses New Game. That collects every card, deals seven cards plus one Laser Pointer to each player, shuffles one exploding cat less than there are players into the deck and picks a random starting player. Nothing has to be placed by hand.

A turn: play as many cards from your hand as you like by dragging them onto the discard pile, then press Draw. That takes the top card of the deck into your hand and passes the turn. If the card is an exploding cat it is put face up in the Danger Zone for everybody to see and you are asked whether you can defuse it.

The buttons (all optional - you can always move cards by hand):
• Draw - draw the top card of the deck and end your turn.
• Defuse - after a Laser Pointer: choose secretly where in the deck the exploding cat goes back, optionally discarding your Laser Pointer, and end your turn.
• Take 1 - pick a card out of the discard pile (the five different cats combo).
• Peek 3 - look at the top three cards, only you see them.
• Shuffle - shuffle the draw pile.
• Steal - choose a player and whether they pick a card for you (Favor), you take a random one (two matching cats) or you name one (three matching cats).
• Pass - end your turn without drawing, for a Skip.
• Attack - end your turn and make the next player take two turns.
• NOPE! - just noise and drama when you cancel somebody's card.
• Sort - tidy up your own cards.

The panel on the right always shows whose turn it is, how many turns they still owe, how many cards are left and how many exploding cats are still hiding in them. The badge on each seat shows that player's hand size, and turns into a red X when they have blown up.

Nothing is enforced: the table never refuses a move, so house rules and corrections are always possible by dragging cards around.
